metrics.spectral_only: max normalized Drude-Lorentz bath spectrum over all eigenvalue gaps
metrics.bath_x_coupling: max spectrum score times uncorrelated site-bath transition coupling between eigenstates
metrics.bath_x_path: max spectrum score times source-sink participation of the eigenstate pair
metrics.bath_x_coupling_x_path: max spectrum score times both transition coupling and source-sink path relevance
